description: Source-of-record registry. Each dataset's `source.type` should match a `source_type` here; `source_id` on a manifest entry references items[].id when an upstream provider is named.

source_types.label: Manual chart extract
source_types.description: Numeric values read off a chart image by hand. Original image path kept in source.source_image.

source_types.label: Primary research
source_types.description: First-party data collected by JourneyMapper (interviews, surveys, panels).

source_types.label: Third-party provider
source_types.description: Data licensed or scraped from a named external provider (e.g. SEMrush, Pathmatics).
